annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT process the FIN flag until all preceding data on the stream has been received
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint must wait until *all* data that was in flight before the FIN is received, before processing the FIN.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint must wait until all data *associated with* the stream, even data that may arrive after the FIN, is received before processing the FIN.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'all preceding data' is open to interpretation. It's unclear whether it refers to data that was in transit when the FIN was sent, or all data associated with the stream, including data that might arrive after the FIN. This affects how an endpoint determines when it's safe to process the FIN.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'preceding data' is not precise. Does it refer to data in flight when the FIN was sent, or all data logically belonging to the stream?
